title: Remote viewing Napoleon's 'War of the Rabbits'

tellings.quote: as the carriage went away he was throwing rabbits out the window. He lost the war to the rabbits.

plain: A remote viewing session, the practice of trying to perceive distant or hidden targets with the mind alone, was aimed at a strange moment in Napoleon's life in France, which the viewer calls the "War of the Rabbits." Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant and remote viewer, tells Michels he took part. He says he saw Napoleon's carriage driving away while Napoleon threw rabbits out of the window, and jokes that "he lost the war to the rabbits."
